candidate_windows.window_text: Each model in our experiments was trained on 8 x 80G A100 GPUs with a learning rate of 1e-5. We set the batch size to 4 for PERSE-7b and 2 for PERSE-13b. The models converged after 2k and 6k steps on Per-MPST, respectively. We trained two unified models on Per-DOC for all aspects by fine-tuning 7b and 13b LLaMA-2-chat. The models after 1k and 2k steps. It takes about 10 hours in total for these two models. For the ablation study, we also trained one model for each aspect on Per-DOC. Each model converged after 500 steps for 7b and 2k steps for 13b. The total training time was approximately 5 x 5 hours.
